One national INGO staff member was reportedly killed by a group of perpetrators stealing cattle from the Pamot cattle camp in Twic East county. Further information is unknown at this time.
One male UN contracted truck driver was shot dead during an ambush by an unknown perpetrator in Nahr Jur.

One UN agency contracted truck carrying food items in the Hokuma-Mafi area between Kapoeta and Torit was ambushed by unknown armed men, shot at and robbed. The assistant driver was shot in his stomach, but managed to reach the hospital in Kapoeta for care and is reported in stable condition.

One UN agency male national staff member was injured after an unknown perpetrator broke into his home in the Bentiu PoC site and assaulted him with a spear. The perpetrators stole 2 mobile phones and a radio that were later recovered in the PoC. The UN staff victim was treated at the UNMISS level II clinic.

One INGO security guard was held at gunpoint at the compound in Juba by a group of unknown intruders. After cutting the fence the intruders cut cables to the AC units and demanded the security guard produce keys for another gate he did not have. The perpetrators then proceeded to drag and beat the security guard. Another guard on duty was able to alert the rapid response team and the perpetrators fled. All AC units were accounted for and the security guard was referred to the local hospital.

Two INGO staff members were injured and one killed, after intense intercommunal clashes and cattle raids broke out in Pieri, Uror country. The INGO had to temporarily suspend operations in the village.

One INGO truck driver was assaulted after he was forced to remain with a truck having mechanical problems through the night near Gumuruk Payam. During the night, 30 armed youths reportedly assaulted and robbed the driver, and the next day he was able to receive medical treatment at a clinic in Pibor.

One NGO vehicle with 3 staff was ambushed in Cuiecok village between Terekeka and Awerial by unknown armed perpetrators demanding money. When the staff refused, the driver was shot in the hand as they left the area.
Two UN Agency truck drivers transporting food to Abiemnom were ambushed and shot by unknown perpetrators after getting stuck in the mud. They managed to drive to Mayom for medical attention.
One NGO staff member, while gathering his cattle in Maboir village, was caught in a cattle raid and killed. The motive is not related to his status as an aid worker.

One UN agency male staff member was injured after being attacked by unknown individuals while walking from the market to his accommodation in the Bentiu PoC. He was sent to an INGO clinic for treatment, but later evacuated to Juba on June 23.

One UN agency contracted truck driver sustained three gunshot wounds when his truck was ambushed by unknown armed men in Bor. The truck was damaged and the driver was taken to the hospital where he is in stable condition.

An INGO ambulance driver was transporting a civilian with a gunshot wound from Manakol village when he was ambushed on the road by unknown armed assailants. He was shot and killed by the assailants in a suspected revenge killing. The wounded passenger escaped.
One humanitarian staff member was reportedly killed in a cattle raid in Duk Payuel while grazing his own cattle.

One INGO hired taxi driver in Juba was ambushed by three unknown men who claimed he was involved in a traffic accident the previous day. Upon denial, the perpetrators assaulted the driver with a pistol handle, robbed him, and ordered him to leave the area. The staff member was referred to a hospital for his injuries.

Two NGO national staff members were shot and killed after being caught in an unknown armed groups attack on the Pajut village in Duk county. The staff were administering health and nutrition services when the indiscriminate gunfire hit the village. 4 other civilians were killed.

One INGO national staff member was kidnapped along with 8 civilians travelling in a private vehicle near Jebel Thiik in River County. Reports indicate the perpetrators are suspected NSAG rouge elements active in the area. The staff was released on August 19 2020 following community interventions.

One UN Agency national staff member was assaulted and injured by unknown criminals in a failed robbery attempt. The staff member was walking back from the market in the Bentiu PoC site when he was attacked. He was treated at a local INGO clinic.

A UN agency convoy was ambuhsed on the Budi-Kapoeta Road near Camp 15 by unknown criminals. The staff were robbed and one humanitarian staff suffered a non-life threatening gunshot wound and was evacuated to Juba.
One INGO national male staff was shot and injured after unknown attackers entered his home in Pibor. Two other family members were shot and killed.

One NGO driver of a two vehicle aid convoy (second vehicle was an ambulance) was shot and wounded between Yei and Lasu near Abegi. Unknown perpetrators ambushed the convoy and shot at the vehicles, striking the driver. All other staff members escaped, but two civilians are missing.
One NGO compound security guard was assaulted by a group of unknown perpetrators who broke into and robbed the NGO compound. The guard was treated for his non-life-threatening injuries.

Four NNGO aid workers were detained by the authorities for allegedly conducting COVID-19 activities without the proper authorisation in Namutina, Western Equatoria. One female aid worker was released two days later and the others some days later.

One NGO driver was shot and wounded after the NGO convoy of 5 contracted trucks were ambushed near Lainya while traveling from Juba to Kupera. The unknown armed perpetrators set fire to two trucks and looted supplies from the others.

One INGO national staff was shot and wounded after he was ambushed on the road in Thokchak by local armed youth fighting between community groups. Reports indicate the youth dispute began at a wedding where many were under the influence of drugs and alcohol.
One female INGO national staff member was beaten by National Security personnel at the gate of the UNMISS compound due to an argument over who her employer was.
Two UN staff members were injured after their vehicle was ambushed 25km outside of Kapoeta.
One male INGO national staff member was shot and killed on the road next to the Bhar El Ghazal hotel in Hai Daraja, Wau. He was also robbed of his motorbike by unknown armed criminals.
One male national INGO staff member was injured after being detained and in police custody in Juba.

One NGO male staff member was reportedly seriously injured during clan clashes between Ying Payam and Nyangore on September 15 on the Sobat river near Ulang town. The staff member succumbed to his wounds the following day at the NGO clinic.
Three INGO staff members were assaulted and injured after their compound in Melut was raided. Reports indicate the host community was unhappy with some of the INGO's policies.

Two INGO staff travelling from Liria to Juba were ambushed in Korgana on September 29th. Despite their injuries, the driver managed to navigate the team to a nearby village where the two injured INGO members could be evacuated to Juba for medical treatment. The driver was given first aid treatment by SSPDF forces at the village.
One male contracted security guard was shot and killed on 30th September by armed persons at a primary health care facility in Lopa/Lafon area. The staff were relocated to Torit Town.

A convoy of UN Agency aid boats in the Shambe area, on route from Bor to Malakal was ambushed by unknown perpetrators on the water. One boat completely sank and a staff member passenger drowned after being shot. Two other staff members received some injuries and were treated locally. A fourth staff member was seriously injured and evacuated to Juba.
One national NGO male staff was reportedly killed after being caught in crossfire while harvesting crops from his farm. Reports indicate the gunfire is attributed to disputing clans in the area.
One NGO driver was shot and killed while travelling on the Cueibet-Rumbek road in Cueibet County. Official Reports indicate the incident is due to armed intercommunal cattle clashes.
One national male INGO staff member was assaulted and injured by civilians on the road in Malakal.
Three INGO staff members were ambushed by unknown perpetrators between Pibor and Tangazon, about 8 kms West of Gumuruk. One staff was reportedly shot and killed, with another being seriously injured.
One NGO staff member in the New Fangak area was shot and killed on route for mission to Korwai by unknown perpetrators.

Two male NGO staff members residing in an NGO compound were injured after three unknown perpetrators raided the compound in Kuachlual Payam, Koch County. The staff were robbed and beaten and later received medical attention at the clinic.
One INGO national male staff member was shot and killed during Tribal clashes in Malakal.

An off-duty INGO driver walking with a group of people from Leer to Koch at 4:00am was ambushed by a group of unknown armed individuals. The staff member was shot and killed by the group for unknown reasons.

The executive director of a NNGO was arrested along with a activist by the police while carrying out a needs assessment for the flood victims in Bor town. They were released the following day without charges and the state police commissioner described the event as unfortunate, issued a formal apology and announced that the officer involved was being investigated.
One national staff was injured after they were shot in a local market during a retaliation attack. Further information on the motive and perpetrator is unknown.
One UN aid worker was arrested by the police after being involved in a traffic incident in an unknown location. The aid worker was released two days later.

One male INGO staff member was taken from his home in Wau town by unknown armed perpetrators and held until January 18, 2021. Official reports indicate the perpetrators accused the staff member of adultery, deprived him of food, and assaulted him. He was released as the accusations were found to be false.

One INGO guard was shot and killed by an unknown armed perpetrator while walking near an INGO warehouse in Akobo town. Reports indicate the incident was a revenge killing and not an attack on the INGO.
One UN national staff was injured after being attacked by an unknown armed group at a project site in Bentiu.
One INGO staff member was reportedly shot and injured after being caught in crossfire while travelling from Banyjur in Paltruk Payam towards Lankien.
One INGO staff member assaulted, robbed and injured by youths while walking in Hai Ngarwalem in Pibor town. The injuries were treated locally.

An NGO vehicle traveling between Kuerguini and Bentiu bridge was attacked by unknown armed youths. One NGO staff member was killed and another was injured in the leg and received treatment at Bentiu Hospital. The motive for the attack is unverified.

One male UN humanitarian agency national staff was shot and injured after the private vehicle he was travelling in was ambushed on the road near the border between Jonglei and Central Equatoria. Reports indicate 10 unknown armed perpetrators ambushed the vehicle near Malithor village, and injured 2 other civilians as well.

Two NGO contracted staff members working at a drilling project site in Kuarabiei village, 6km from Yirol town, were attacked and injured by an unknown perpetrator. Both staff members suffered serious injuries to their heads and arms and were treated at the hospital. Initial reports indicate the perpetrator may have been under the influence of alcohol.

A vehicle convoy contracted by an NGO for a polio vaccination campaign was ambushed by unknown armed men on the Maper Road in Rumbek Centre between Apek and Alacok. 4 NGO contractors were shot and killed and 4 others were seriously wounded.
One male NGO contracted driver was shot and injured in the Koch town market by unknown perpetrators. Reports indicate the attack is not likely related to his NGO affiliation.

Actor name: Sudan People's Liberation Army-in-Opposition (SPLA-IO) affiliated youth
Details: One male NGO staff member was seriously beaten by a group of youths reportedly affiliated with the SPLA-IO. Reports indicate he was near Leka village, 3km from Bunj town retrieving his cows from a grazing area.
One INGO national nutrition worker was shot and killed in a roadside ambush in Tonj North.
One NGO staff member was shot and wounded by an unaffiliated individual over a personal dispute in Thonoum Payam, Unity.
One male NGO staff member was shot and injured after his commercial vehicle was ambushed by unknown gunmen on the road in the vicinity of Gumuruk, while returning to his duty station.

One female NGO staff on her way home from duty in the Bentiu PoC site, was stopped by two joint force personnel. The security personnel directed the staff member to remove her trousers due to an alleged dress code for women in the camp. The staff member was assaulted when she refused as the perpetrators attempted to physically remove her trousers with a knife, before bystanders intervened.
Two NGO staff members were assaulted and wounded between Lonyoro and Longiro, Lafon County, after their vehicle was ambushed by unknown perpetrators.
One NGO staff member was injured after he was assaulted during a robbery in Pibor. He was treated locally.
Four INGO staff were assaulted and injured after a group of 15-20 youths raided the compound in the Jam Jang humanitarian hub. 1 Staff was airlifted for treatment.
One NGO staff member travelling with his family in a commercial minibus along the Waat-Bor road, was kidnapped and killed when the vehicle was ambushed by unknown perpetrators.
Two UN aid workers were kidnapped by SPLA-IO when they took the wrong direction while traveling between Bissella and Fanjar, Wau, Western Bahr el Ghazal. The aid workers were released a day later.

One UN staff member was seriously injured after he was assaulted by a mob of community members that raided a project site in Torit. Reports indicated the assault and intrusion occurred following a protest regarding UN/INGO employment bias in the community.
One INGO medical staff was seriously injured after their mobile medical team was ambushed and assaulted by intoxicated soldiers in Karic, on route to Amongpiny.
Two NGO contracted drivers in an aid convoy were seriously injured after they were ambushed and beaten by Murle perpetrators near Gadiang.
One INGO staff guard was shot and killed after an unknown armed group raided Gumuruk, Jonglei.
One female INGO staff was injured near the Landmark Hotel in Juba when an unknown man threw a rock at her, knocking her down. She was treated at a local clinic.
One INGO staff member was injured during a violent compound raid by unknown perpetrators in Renk town.
One INGO Ugandan staff member was reportedly shot and killed after his vehicle was ambushed in the vicinity of Camp 15, Budi.
An INGO community worker was one of 7 civilians killed in a cattle raid in Guech, Kuach Payam.

City: Between Malual Mouk and Tonj South
Details: One UN agency contracted driver was stabbed in the hand after his convoy was ambushed and robbed by suspected Malual Mouk criminals.
One INGO driver and a motorcycle were in a collision on Airport road, Juba. A crowd gathered due to the incident and the driver was assaulted by the mob.
One male INGO doctor was killed in the medical clinic in Ganyiel, Unity.
One UN driver was assaulted and injured, when a large group of Monyumiji youth, protesting humanitarian organisation presence in the community, attacked his vehicle.

Two INGO staff members were killed when their convoy travelling on the Mapourdit-Aluakluak road was ambushed by unknown armed perpetrators. The perpetrators fired on one vehicle, killing both staff, and occupants of the other vehicle were unharmed.
One NGO staff member was shot and killed walking home in Chukudum, Budi.
One INGO staff member was shot and killed by an unknown attacker at the office compound in Nyal.
One guard at a humanitarian organisation run primary school was shot and killed when unknown perpetrators raided the school and stole food items and school kits in Machi, Kapoeta South.
One NGO staff member was wounded and later died from his injuries in the hospital after being assaulted by a group of individuals in Akobo town. Reports suggest it was over a personal issue.
One UN Congolese staff member transporting livelihood kits to Yirol East county was ambushed and shot by unknown armed perpetrators. He managed to drive to Yirol town for medical attention.
Two staff members, one female staff from an INGO and one male from a partner NGO, were injured after their group was ambushed and assaulted near Nestiu town, Juba County.
One NGO community health worker was shot and injured by a group of unknown youths between Ngop payam and Cueibet town.

Two UN staff members and one INGO staff were injured after a group of refugees temporarily took them hostage at a food distribution project in Yusuf Batil and assaulted them. They received minor medical care.
One driver was shot and killed in an INGO contracted convoy after it was attacked by unknown gunmen near Aru junction on the Juba-Nimule road.
One NGO staff member was assaulted after he was stopped on his motorcycle and robbed in Ezo county on the Yambio-Tambura road. He was able to reach a nearby medical centre after the attack.
One INGO compound guard was seriously beaten when unknown perpetrators raided the compound in New Fangak. Another guard was able to activate the alarm and nothing was taken before they fled.
One UN agency contracted compound guard was shot and killed by unknown gunmen in Bentiu.

At least two NGO health workers were reportedly abducted from the Lasu Refugee Camp after an unknown armed group raided the camp, stole items from the facility, damaged an ambulance, and abducted other residents.
One NGO staff member was reportedly killed in crossfire during community clashes in Tombura town.
One UN contracted male daily worker was injured after being assaulted by 6 unknown armed men on his way to work in Bor town.

A UN agency NGO implementing partner aid convoy was ambushed 30km from Yei on the Yei-Kaya road near Ligi, by an unknown armed group. The driver was killed, one staff was injured, and the other 3 were kidnapped. Their whereabouts is unknown.
One international UN staff member was injured after being assaulted by a UN contractor over payment issues in Malakal.
One INGO Country Director was arrested on his way home from work and detained for more than a week in Juba. Reports indicate after his detention, the security forces deported him to Sudan.
One INGO security guard was injured after he was assaulted during a criminal raid on a health facility project site in Nyamlel, Aweil West. There was a temporary program suspension.

One international and one national UN contractor was shot and wounded when their UN contracted barge came under fire from unknown gunmen when travelling between Gakdon and Dengjok in Akobo. The barge had just delivered food and was returning from the contracted mission.
An INGO national staff in Pigi county was shot and killed after being caught in fighting between SPLA IO factions.

One UN national staff member was reportedly ambushed by unknown gunmen along the Juba-Nimule road in Maqwi county. Some reports indicate the staff member managed to escape the attack, but no communication has been received from the staff member.
One INGO male staff was killed in his home in Yei town. Further information is unavailable at this time.
Two INGO staff contracted to operate a cash distribution site in Kaya Refugee Camp were assaulted and injured by refugees upset with the speed of the distribution.

One INGO staff member was shot and injured after an intoxicated man entered a public market area in Lasu refugee camp, begun demanding money and then opened fire. One other civilian (not counted here) was killed.
One NGO staff member was one of 10 civilians killed in community clashes in Gakdong, Akobo county.
One NGO driver was detained for one day after his vehicle was stopped at an SPLO-IO checkpoint in Bagari Payam. The vehicle was not released until November 21.
Two INGO staff and a guard were injured after unknown armed men raided the organisation compound and stole money at gunpoint.
One INGO national staff member was killed after being caught in community violence between armed youths and others in Leer.
One NGO staff member was killed by a family member in an interpersonal dispute in Aweil town.
One NGO staff member was killed in a clash between opposing youths in Kong Kong Payam, Jonglei on his way home from work.
One UN agency staff was killed and another injured after their convoy was ambushed by unknown armed men between Duk Padiet and Tindiir, Jonglei.
One INGO national staff member was assaulted and injured by a group of community youths over an age set dispute. The staff was evacuated to Juba for medical treatment.
One INGO staff member was beaten by other employees at his home in Pibor for not adhering to age set customs.
One female NGO staff was shot and injured in an attempted robbery on her house by unknown criminals in Guolpiny village, Koch.
One female INGO aid worker was sexually harassed by a civilian in Juba.
One off-duty NGO guard was shot and killed in a suspected revenge killing incident between clans as he was repairing his home in Walgak, Akobo.
One NGO staff member was reportedly stabbed by suspected gang members in Hai Joppa, Juba city.
One INGO nurse was killed and two other NGO staff injured in inter-communal fighting in Agok, Rumamer county, Abyei.
One INGO staff was killed in crossfire during inter-communal fighting in Mir Mir, Unity.
Three NGO staff members were injured after they were attacked by unknown gunmen on the road near MirMir.

One male national UN staff member was detained by National Security Services (NSS) personnel in Wau, Western Bahr El Ghazal. He was released three days later on February 17, 2021. It seems that the arrest was in connection with a matter not related to his humanitarian work.
One INGO staff member was killed during by crossfire in Leer, Unity.
One NGO staff driver was reportedly shot and killed on his way to the office by unknown perpetrators, some reports indicate it may be related to a personal dispute.
One UN contracted truck driver was ambushed and assaulted by suspected Murle Tribesmen who robbed him, on the Bor-Gadiang road.
One INGO national staff driver was shot in the leg after his vehicle was ambushed by unknown armed men 15km east of Kapoeta.
One off duty NGO staff was reportedly shot and killed in Hiyala, Torit for unknown reasons.
One national male UN-contracted aid worker was beaten and injured by an unknown aid recipient in POC Camp, Malakal.
A truck contracted by an NGO to transport materials to Lankien was ambushed by unknown gunmen and one of the foreign national staff was shot and killed.

One male national NGO staff member was arrested from his office by the South Sudan People's Defence Forces (SSPDF). Reports indicate that four motorbikes, a laptop and a desktop were also seized. The staff member was released on March 25, 2022.

Two UN agency contracted staff were killed and another staff was injured after their aid convoy of 17 trucks was ambushed by unknown armed perpetrators between Gadiang and Yuai in Uror county. Two other passengers who were onboard the trucks were killed too (not counted).
One INGO security guard was beaten by six unidentified persons armed with AK-47 rifles who broke into an INGO compound and robbed three mobile phones, money, food, and medical supplies.
One INGO staff member was killed in suspected intercommunal violence that took place in Leer country during April 8-11.
One UN agency truck driver assistant was beaten with a rifle after his truck was ambushed between Lohutok and Ibahure, Lafon county.
One off-duty INGO national aid worker on a motorcycle was attacked by stones thrown by three individuals in an attempted robbery. The victim later died in hospital.
One NGO staff member was reportedly killed in a suspected revenge attack in Duk Pagaak.
One NGO staff member was injured at a checkpoint when an official held up a rope that got tangled in the staff members motorcycle. He was also allegedly assaulted.
Two NGO staff members were kidnapped in Minga payam by an unknown group. They were released on July 25, 2022.
Two male NGO staff members were kidnapped by an unknown armed group while carrying out a humanitarian assessment 240km NE of Yambio in Mundri East county. Their whereabouts are currently unknown.
One INGO national staff was reportedly shot and injured by his girlfriend in Pibor.

One NGO staff was injured in an incident after a regular forces staff member was shot and killed in a community in Ikotos county. Prison forces responded to the incident and killed 2 people in the community and injured the NGO staff.
One driver and one driver assistant were shot and wounded by unknown armed men in Eastern Equatoria.
Two INGO national staff members were killed after their vehicle was ambushed by unknown armed individuals while travelling between Ikotos and Tsertenya.
Five humanitarian health workers were reportedly detained for more than 24 hours by a Kitgwang armed faction in Ngony, Koch. The exact release information is unknown at this time.
A national UN staff member was arrested in Rumbek. The arrest was due to motives not related to their humanitarian. The exact release information is unknown at this time.
One NGO staff member, after withdrawing a large amount of cash, was attacked in his home by unknown men. He was robbed and later thrown in a nearby well.
One NGO staff member was shot and killed walking between work locations by suspected Murle Tribesman. Motive is unknown at this time.

One UN agency staff administering polio vaccines was shot and killed in a camp near Bentiu town as he conducted visits to the health sites. Reports indicate the shooting was due to a territorial revenge dispute.

City: Between Chieng Kuol and Chieng Yaar
Details: One NGO staff member was killed after being shot in crossfire during intercommunal fighting between Chieng Koul and Chieng Yaar communities.

Actor name: Chieng Kuol and Chieng Yaar communities
Details: One male national UN bodyguard was killed at the warehouse during an intercommunal fight between Chieng Kuol and Chieng Yaar communities. Five other people were also killed (not counted).
One driver from an INGO was injured when the vehicle was ambushed by unknown actors close to Ngarere village, along the Camp 15 - Chukudum road, Eastern Equatoria.
One INGO staff member, travelling from Camp 15, was shot and injured after their vehicle was ambushed by unknown armed elements in Chukudum payam, Budi.

One local staff member was taken from their compound by armed youths and seriously assaulted. The victim received treatment for their injuries at a medical facility in Leer town. This incident occurred in Mayendit County.
One male NGO staff member was shot and injured by a colleague over a beneficiary dispute in a residential area of Ikotos.
One male national INGO aid worker was robbed and injured in his home in Bentiu, Unity.
One NGO staff was shot and killed, one injured and a third was kidnapped for 2 days after an armed group raided a nutrition site in Biyien village.

One national INGO aid worker was assaulted and arrested by patrolling members of the South Sudanese government for unknown reasons in Yambio, Western Equatoria. The aid worker was released on November 19.
One UN food supplier contracted truck driver was injured by a soldier at the Tharkueng checkpoint on his way to Kuajok.
One INGO aid worker was detained by the police over a dispute about not having paid a subcontractor in Ulang, Upper Nile. The aid worker was released the next day.

One driver of the Logistics Cluster was robbed and injured by unidentified individuals while transporting supplies along the Juba-Torit Road in Lirya Payam, Juba County. The driver's personal belongings, cash, and cartons of food items were taken.

One INGO national staff was shot during an ambush by armed Nuer youths while travelling near Auya-wangeny village to Kodok Town using a canoe. The whereabouts of his family remain unclear. (Not counted).

Three local UN contractors were stopped and harassed for several hours by the police on the demand of the Guit County Commissioner in Bentiu Town, Rubkotne Payam, Rubkona County. The driver sustained injuries, and the phones of the aid workers were confiscated.
One UN agency contracted senior guard was physically assaulted by an unidentified actor in Rumbek Town, Matangai Payam, Rumbek Center County.
Two NGO national workers were ambushed and killed by alleged Murle youth when moving from Pajut to Tiam, Duk County, Jonglei.

Two local bodyguards of a national NGO were killed during an armed clash in Rumamer village, Abyei, Warrap. The NGO is an implementing partner of a UN agency. A total of 14 people, including women and children, died in the attack.
One NNGO contracted guard was attacked and killed by armed Murle tribesmen in Duk. An unknown quantity of food was stolen from the NGO facility.
One national NGO aid worker was injured by a gunshot from armed Murle youth along the Lankien-Waat Road in Waat area, Nyirol County.

One national NGO staff was killed and another was injured while assisting the victims of a raid conducted by Murle youths in Walgat town, Nyirol, Jonglei. Both staff were off-duty at the time of the incident and were assisting community members as civilians.
One national INGO security guard was injured by a stray bullet from a clash between Murle tribesman and local youth of the Mwot Tot area in Uror County.
One UN-contracted boat leader was kidnapped by youths who demanded an increase in food ratios in Buong, Ulang, Upper Nile. The boat leader was released two days after.
One national NGO worker was injured when unknown armed men raided the organisation compound in Pibor, Jonglei. The attackers targeted the NGO looking for cash and other assets to be stolen.
Two national NGO workers were injured when unknown armed actors raided their compound and stole a mobile phone.

Three INGO aid workers were kidnapped by unknown armed actors during an ambush in Mugwo, Yei, Central Equatoria. The perpetrators were demanding a ransom for the release of the aid workers. They were released two days later, after negotiations. No ransom was paid.
One INGO aid worker was shot and killed for unknown reasons during an ambush in Bur, Torit, Eastern Equatoria.
One female NGO aid worker was assaulted and injured by alleged Toronto Boys members who robbed her belongings in Juba, Central Equatoria. The aid worker received medical attention after the incident.
One female INGO aid worker was kidnapped by unknown armed actors during an ambush along the Yei-Kaya road in Central Equatoria. The whereabouts of the aid worker remain unknown.
One UN-contracted driver was attacked by unknown actors while sleeping inside a UN vehicle outside a UN compound in Hai Mattar, Pibor, Jonglei.
Five INGO aid workers were killed and three aid workers were injured during an ambush by Murle tribesmen in Payuel, Duk, Jonglei. An unknown number of civilians were also killed.
One local UN aid worker was arrested by the Criminal Investigation Department in connection with an alleged domestic matter in Juba, Central Equatoria.
One NGO aid worker was shot and killed by unknown actors while traveling back to Jebel Boma after submitting humanitarian reports in Pibor, Jonglei.
One UN-contracted boat driver was arrested by the local authorities over the non-payment of taxes associated with a UN convoy mission in Malaka, Upper Nile.
One NGO aid worker was arrested by local authorities over allegations of being linked to a communal meeting that ended in misunderstanding among participants in Kodok, Fashoda, Upper Nile.
Two aid workers were kidnapped by unknown armed actors who demanded a ransom along the Yei-Kaya road, in Central Equatoria. Their whereabouts remain unknown.
Three INGO-contracted aid workers were kidnapped by unknown armed men and their vehicle was set on fire along the Mundri-Juba road, Mundri East, Western Equatoria. Their whereabouts remain unknown.
One INGO-contracted driver was kidnapped by unknown armed actors while preparing for Ebola-related activities in Mugwo, Yei, Central Equatoria. The driver was released a day later.
Three UN aid workers were kidnapped by unknown armed actors during an ambush along the Yei-Lasu road in Central Equatoria. Their whereabouts remain unknown.
One INGO community nutrition worker was killed by armed youth in an alleged revenge act along the Rumbek-Maper road, Rumbek Centre, Lakes.

One UN aid worker was attacked and injured by a mob after being involved in a road traffic accident while driving a private vehicle in Juba, Central Equatoria. The aid worker was transferred to a hospital after the incident.
One male UN aid worker was shot dead by unknown actors in Bieh camp, Bentiu, Unity.
Two NNGO aid workers were kidnapped by unknown armed actors at the Yei-Maridi road. Their whereabouts remain unknown.

One male international INGO country director and one national INGO aid worker were detained by the authorities over allegations of discussing politics in Juba, Central Equatoria. There is no information about a formal trial.
